summary: Adds an automated QEMU hardware test matrix integrated into NovaOryn Test Explorer.

usb: xHCI with USB keyboard and mouse
firmware: legacy BIOS where a BIOS boot artifact exists

execution: Balanced matrix varies individual dimensions around a known-good baseline and includes a combined stress case.
Full Cartesian matrix generates every supported combination.
The selected OS is built once before the matrix begins.
Each QEMU case has a clean run directory and serial log.
Acceptance requires both NovaOryn KMain startup and the interactive NovaOryn prompt.
Legacy BIOS is explicitly skipped as not applicable for an EFI-only build rather than being reported as tested.
A versioned NovaOryn.QemuHardwareMatrix.json report is written under the OS .novaoryn test results directory.
